subject.title: fix(security): bound plugin manifest reads in audit deep scan

question: Should deep audit cap installed plugin `package.json` reads at 1 MiB and use directory-only fallback when the package manifest exceeds that limit?
rationale: The cap removes an unbounded untrusted-file read, but oversized manifests can no longer provide `openclaw.extensions` entries for explicit scanning of paths normally skipped by directory traversal.

options.title: Accept bounded fallback
options.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit, warning, and directory-only fallback for oversized package manifests.

options.title: Preserve declared entries
options.body: Pause merge and require a different bounded extraction design that retains `openclaw.extensions` coverage.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded fallback
recommendation.body: Keep the 1 MiB limit, warning, and directory-only fallback for oversized package manifests.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and merged the exact deep-audit scan-coverage behavior whose boundary this PR changes.
